title: The popular version. The ozone hole was fixed years ago.
description:
The ozone hole was fixed years ago. It is recovering, not recovered. The 2022 UN assessment expects the layer to return to 1980 values by 2040 over most of the world, and around 2066 over Antarctica.

British Antarctic Survey scientists whose results showed abnormally low ozone above Halley Bay near the South Pole.

Two years later, nations agreed to act. The Montreal Protocol was agreed on 16 September 1987 and entered into force on 1 January 1989.

Every UN member state signed up. Wikipedia describes it as the first universally ratified treaty in United Nations history. As of October 2022 that covered every UN member state.

Nearly this share of banned ozone depleting substances has been phased out, according to UN News citing the 2022 assessment.

It also avoided some warming. UN News says the Protocol has helped avoid an estimated 0.5 degrees Celsius of global warming.

A hole found in 1985 may not close until 2066.

Sources:
- https://news.un.org/en/story/2023/01/1132277: read in full (UN News, January 2023, on the 2022 Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion). Established the nearly 99 per cent phase out of banned ozone depleting substances, recovery to 1980 values by 2040 for most of the world, about 2045 over the Arctic and about 2066 over the Antarctic if current policies hold, the hole first announced in May 1985 by three British Antarctic Survey scientists, and an estimated 0.5 degrees Celsius of warming avoided.
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montreal_Protocol: first about 40,000 of 83,000 characters read verbatim. Established agreement on 16 September 1987, entry into force on 1 January 1989, the first universally ratified treaty in United Nations history (all UN member states as of October 2022), the names Farman, Gardiner and Shanklin with the Halley Bay result, and recovery years of 2066, 2045 and 2040.
- https://ozone.unep.org/treaties/montreal-protocol: read in full (UNEP Ozone Secretariat). Corroborated signature in 1987 and entry into force in 1989.
